cognitive_contract.label: Explain / structural mechanisms & invariants (National/International Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Analyzing and articulating deep structural mechanisms, projective/topological invariants, or failure barriers governing elite competition theorems to establish protected claim W.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to formulate the core geometric projection invariance, lattice partition parity, or deficient neighborhood obstruction mechanism without intermediate scaffolding.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Activate the structural framing or coordinate setup without articulating the decisive invariant mechanism.

slots.X: explaining the structural mechanism by which circular inversion maps circles through the center of inversion to straight lines
slots.Y: circle passing through inversion center O with diameter OA of length d, inverted with respect to circle Omega(O, R)
slots.Z: orthogonal projection invariance: for any point P on the circle, OP * cos(angle POA) = d, so OP' * cos(angle POA) = R^2 / d is constant
slots.W: the orthogonal projection of P' onto diameter ray OA is constant at R^2/d, forcing the locus of P' to be a straight line perpendicular to OA
slots.wrong_idea: assuming circular inversion transforms circles into circles of different radii, failing to recognize that the point at origin maps to the point at infinity
slots.replacement_rule: inversion transforms the diameter endpoint to a fixed distance R^2/d and every chord through O to a point whose projection on OA is fixed, producing a line
slots.visual_job: render circle passing through origin O with diameter OA and chord OP, showing inverted points A' and P' forming a right-angled triangle on the line; avoid unmounted SVGs
slots.check_job: independent verification: choose coordinates with O at origin, circle (x - d/2)^2 + y^2 = (d/2)^2 => x^2 + y^2 = dx. Inverted coordinates (u, v) = (R^2 x / (x^2+y^2), R^2 y / (x^2+y^2)) => u = R^2 x / (dx) = R^2 / d, which is the vertical line x = R^2 / d. Mechanism verified.

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Exact formulation of an international Olympiad structural mechanism explanation demand
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 activates the geometric/algebraic framing; H2 provides intermediate projection/partition equation; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; complete formal explanation detailing the underlying invariant
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student conceptual confusion or superficial justification

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters or textual answer in Core 1A text

core1b_reconstruction.model_alternation: Reconstruction must use an alternative analytical pathway (e.g. Cartesian coordinates or homothety)

core2a_supported_practice.transfer_obligation: Near-transfer item explaining a related structural transformation mechanism

core2b_transfer_assessment.transfer_obligation: Far-transfer item applying the structural explanation mechanism to an Olympiad problem
